scripts.test: turbo run test && npm run test:android-config
scripts.ios:build:simulator: npm exec --workspace @tiprelay/android -- eas-cli build --platform ios --profile simulator
scripts.ios:build:preview: npm exec --workspace @tiprelay/android -- eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.ios:build:release: npm exec --workspace @tiprelay/android -- eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.cdk:synth: npm run backend:build && npm run cdk -- synth
scripts.cdk:diff: npm run backend:build && npm run cdk -- diff
scripts.cdk:deploy: npm run backend:build && npm run cdk -- deploy
scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: npm run backend:build && npm run cdk -- deploy TipRelayDev -c stage=development --outputs-file .local/aws-outputs.json
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: npm run backend:build && npm run cdk -- deploy TipRelayProd -c stage=production --outputs-file .local/aws-outputs-production.json
scripts.cdk:deploy:speech:dev: npm run cdk -- deploy TipRelaySpeechBuildDev -c stage=development --outputs-file .local/speech-build-outputs.json
scripts.cdk:deploy:speech:prod: npm run cdk -- deploy TipRelaySpeechBuildProd -c stage=production --outputs-file .local/speech-build-outputs-production.json
